tooltip.flyimpact.hybridization_guide.re: Patchouli is required to read this guidebook
patchouli.flyimpact.landing: Welcome to the Flyimpact hybridization guide.$(br2)This book is a tree, not a list: open a fly chapter to see its parents and what it can breed into. Links jump between related chapters.$(br2)Some recipes only appear when Create, AE2, Mekanism, or Touhou Little Maid is installed.
patchouli.flyimpact.subtitle: Flyimpact Field Guide
patchouli.flyimpact.category.intro.desc: How breeding works, and how to read this book.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.dye.desc: Color varieties and the starter lines.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.ore.desc: Metal and gem flies. Mod-gated recipes are hidden until those mods load.
patchouli.flyimpact.category.extra.desc: Extra flies added by this addon.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page0: Each fly has its own chapter. Open it to see how to obtain that fly, then follow $(thing)Related Chapters$() to walk the hybridization tree.$(br2)Click highlighted names to jump.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page1: The breeding chest combines two flies. Same variety purifies; different varieties cross. Progress goes through synapsis, segregation, then assortment.$(br2)Mutation chance is shown in each recipe chapter.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.overview.page2: You receive this guidebook the first time you join a world. If you lose it, craft a book with a normal fly and maggots.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.breeding.page0: Put two flies in a breeding chest. If they match a loaded recipe, the chest can produce the child fly.$(br2)The progress tooltip shows whether you are crossing or purifying.
patchouli.flyimpact.entry.breeding.page1: Recipes in this book come from PoopSky and Flyimpact. Conditional recipes vanish from the tree when their required mod is missing.
jei.flyimpact.breeding_chest.missing_fli: Missing the required fly types in your inventory
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.blaze: Feed a fly a blaze rod, or breed a Dragon Fruit Fly with an Orange Fly
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.wheat: Feed a normal fly wheat, or breed a Green Fly with a Lime Fly
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.pumpkin: Feed a fly a pumpkin, or breed a Yellow Fly with an Orange Fly. The Fly Barrel has a 25%% chance to output a carved pumpkin
jei.flyimpact.fly_desc.fairy: Touhou Little Maid integration. Breed a Red Fly with a Pink Fly. The Fly Barrel outputs Power Points
